1879072548.name: Flaming Arrow
1879072548.desc: A fire tipped arrow which will continue to burn the target after landing.

1879073700.name: Hindering Shot
1879073700.desc: A shaft aimed to slow the movement of your quarry.

1879094820.name: Advanced Warding Knowledge
1879094820.desc:
Creates a circle in which enemies are vulnerable to tactical damage and more likely to miss.

Circle remains for 1 minute.

Affects the following:
Dead, Unseen, Creatures of Nature, Insects, and Drakes.

1879096868.name: Scribe Manual: Cowbell
1879096868.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the cowbell. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879109284.name: Rousing Words
1879109284.desc:
A channelled skill that heals Morale with every second.

+2 to Healing attunement.

This skill generates no threat. Allies affected for at least 5 seconds will gain a tier of Writ of Health.

conditionalEffects.description: Epic for The Ages, Mending Verse, and Rousing Words heal the Rune-keeper for:  *

procEffects.description: Frost Armour: \n Healing skills have a  *  chance to apply:

1879157284.name: Warrior
1879157284.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Warrior.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish, while out of combat.</rgb>

1879176356.name: Burglar's Antidote
1879176356.desc: Cure one or two harmful conditions affecting you.

1879197732.name: Staff Sweep
1879197732.desc: Sweeps the staff to strike surrounding foes.

1879199524.name: Fiery Ridicule
1879199524.desc: The ridicule a Rune-keeper writes hurts more than a mundane scribe's ever could. The damage over time tiers up on subsequent uses.

1879209892.name: Steed of the Guardian
1879209892.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the guardian.

1879226916.name: Ring of Acid
1879226916.desc: Utilize the power of Acid to counter Saruman's attempts to drain this ring of its power.

1879230500.name: Howl from the Shadow
1879230500.desc: You let loose an eerie howl, silencing enemies around you and briefly entering stealth.

1879231268.name: Javelin and Javelin
1879231268.desc: Mastery over the Javelin: Allows Warden to perform Javelin Gambits quickly.

1879231396.name: Ranged Power Attack
1879231396.desc: A powerful weapon blow which deals damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879241636.name: Cry of the Eorlingas
1879241636.desc: Crying for the people of Rohan, you inspire an ally to take heart and find strength.

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

1879244196.name: Caution
1879244196.desc: Your cry warns your target of your ferocity and forces them to ride alongside you at a distance for a short time.

1879270436.name: Rapid Fire
1879270436.desc: Rapidly draw and fire shots with ease.

1879277988.name: Concession and Rebuttal: Shocking Words
1879277988.desc:
A lightning attack dealing +Damage and +Stun duration per attunement consumed.
 
 Requires Battle Attunement.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Stun replaced with a mount speed debuff</rgb>

1879305764.name: Dorking Chicken
1879305764.desc: Summons a Dorking chicken to brighten your day.

1879338916.name: Golden Bat
1879338916.desc: Brings out a golden bat to keep you company.

1879344420.name: Arel
1879344420.desc: A horse once ridden by Laerdan.

1879368612.name: Picnic Steed
1879368612.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879406756.name: Dorking Carrying Chicken
1879406756.desc: Carry around your prized Dorking chicken.

1879411748.name: Wild Chocolate Donkey
1879411748.desc: Summons a loveable wild donkey travelling companion.

1879414436.name: Call Radhril
1879414436.desc: Blow the horn to summon Radhril to your side.

1879415716.name: Portent of Vitality
1879415716.desc: A quick burst of vitality, increasing your maximum morale and healing you.

1879454884.name: Return to Swanfleet
1879454884.desc: You're able to quickly return to Lhan Garan in Swanfleet. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879459108.name: Will to Carry On
1879459108.desc: Your Herald stands steadfastly by your side, carrying on even through great hardship.

1879459364.name: Test Power Restore
1879459364.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879467812.name: Savage Knockdown
1879467812.desc: Consuming all of your Wrath, you put all your energy into a savage attack that damages and knocks down up to 5 enemies before you, allowing your escape.

procEffects.description: Bestial Fury: \n Whenever you Critically Hit with skills you gain:
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.
Vexation: \n Upon taking damage in Man form (20% chance in bear form):
Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.

1879468836.name: War-steed: Light
1879468836.desc: The Courser is a lightly armoured War-steed. Fast and agile, the Courser provides the greatest speed and maneuverability on the battlefield, trading Endurance and Armour to retain their nimbleness.

1879490724.name: Mirkwood Sabre-cat
1879490724.desc: Summons a faithful sabre-cat to accompany you on your travels.

1879508004.name: Combat Focus
1879508004.desc: Before combat, rapidly increase your Focus.\n\nFocus is required to use some bow skills and is lost if you move.

conditionalEffects.description: The Focus skill causes your next Focus Spender skill to apply Weakness, reducing your target's Outgoing Damage.

1879508772.name: Guide to Jiret-menêsh
1879508772.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Jiret-menêsh in An Shêru in Mûr Ghala.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879522084.name: Sandstorm is Coming
1879522084.desc: What is that you hear? Sounds like a sandstorm is rolling in.

1879529124.name: Drop the Fragment of the Crown
1879529124.desc: Drop the Army of Angmar's artifact.

1879532324.name: Bait the Enemy
1879532324.desc: Your killing blows have a 1% chance to draw out a Wolf of Mordor or a lesser Thyrs. Ends when it triggers.
